focus.en: Serial loops, nested routing, reusable submission checks, evidence-grounded feedback and correct score aggregation.
focus.zh-CN: 串行循环、嵌套分支、作业检查复用、有依据的反馈和正确成绩汇总。

buildTitle.en: Build · Submission checks and class report
buildTitle.zh-CN: 搭建 · 作业检查与班级周报

buildPrompt.en: Deduplicate submissions, distinguish missing work from submitted scores, generate follow-up tasks and a class report, and add evidence-grounded learning feedback. Missing submissions must not lower the submitted-score average.
buildPrompt.zh-CN: 作业提交去重后区分缺交和已提交成绩，生成跟进事项、班级周报和有依据的学习反馈。计算平均分时不要把缺交算作零分。

buildResult.en: The three unique submissions include one missing submission. The submitted-score average is 72 from scores 86 and 58; missing work is listed separately.
buildResult.zh-CN: 三份唯一提交中有一份缺交。已提交成绩 86 和 58 的平均分为 72，缺交单独列出。

changeTitle.zh-CN: 变更 · 学习跟进阈值

changePrompt.en: Raise the default practice follow-up threshold from 60 to 90 and save a new revision. Verify that the 86-point submission now receives practice follow-up, while missing work stays distinct.
changePrompt.zh-CN: 把默认巩固跟进阈值从 60 提高到 90，保存新版本，确认 86 分作业进入巩固清单，缺交仍单独处理。
